name: Verity Ballast
description: Measure the throwing arm's reach from axle to tip with a marked cord and note how far each notch sends the shot.

name: Vitaltackle
description: Pack the axle with tallow and spin the arm by hand until the beam turns without drag.

name: Remnant Shortarm
description: Hang the loaded sling from a scale cord and read where the load sits against the arm tip.

name: Restoring Hangcradle
description: Pack the box ballast evenly from front to back so the long arm rises without twisting on its axle.

name: Intent Releasehook
description: Draw qi from the legs through the back into the winch handles for one smooth heave that sets the arm.

name: Splitting Whiplash
description: Free the pin at the very crest of the arm's rise so the sling flies out along the longest line.

name: Slingpouch Maelstrom
description: Let the arm travel to its full reach before the sling frees so the shot leaves with the whole swing behind it.

name: Counterswing Barrage
description: Pour qi along the arm into the sling at release so the shot carries the thrower's force through a shield or rampart.

name: Slag Tackle
description: Gather qi through a long winding then loose a mixed load that falls across the far end of the field.

name: Mightpulley
description: Roster fresh crewmen to the winch in relays so the strongest never tire before the shot count is done.

name: Perceptive Pullrope
description: Stage heaped shot beside each engine in the order of use so no crewman walks far with a load.

name: Fulcrum Linctus
description: Keep a spare release pin and sling ring in hand and swap them in one motion if either fouls.

name: Waningarm
description: Pass a palm along each cable between shots and feel for the heat of friction before a strand burns through.

name: Mighttackle
description: Match the breath of the whole crew to the winch beat so no one gasps between shots.

name: Discerning Rigging
description: Begin the next winding the instant the shot leaves so the arm rises while the crew is still clear.

name: Waning Pullrope
description: Carry the range from one shot to the next by shifting a single marked notch rather than ranging again.

name: Swing Maelstrom
description: Loose each shot on the same count as the one before so a steady rhythm of stones falls in one place.

name: Transfixing Shortarm
description: Sustain a flow of qi through crew and engine so each shot falls on the last and no head is raised.

name: Nova Heaveoff
description: Drive qi into three shots in succession on one mark so each blow widens the break left by the last.

name: Waning Tackle
description: Study the face of the rampart through the dust of a trial shot to find the course where the stone is weakest.

name: Sustaining Longarm
description: Mark the winch notch and the pin that gave the best landing so the same shot can be repeated all day.

name: Daybreak Releasehook
description: Choose the heaviest shot the arm will bear without cracking and reserve it for the main breach.

name: Remnant Rigging
description: Read the plume where a shot meets masonry to tell whether the stone cracked or only shed grit.

name: Ballast Onslaught
description: Strike the same course of stone with every shot until the mortar joint opens and the face spalls.

name: Intent Fulcrum
description: Throw shot along the crown of the rampart to clear defenders from the walk before the breach is worked.

name: Heavy Letgo
description: Drive qi through the shot into a cracked joint so it opens deeper and wider than the stone's weight alone.

name: Splitting Overthrow
description: Fling the shot with qi packed into its core so it cracks a defender's ward across the rampart face.

name: Vital Longarm
description: Space the engines along the line so the arc of no beam reaches the crew of its neighbour.

name: Hangcradle Tincture
description: Set a painted pole at the battery's center that every engine crew can see for range and halt signs.

name: Daybreak Slingpouch
description: Call each engine by its number in turn so every crew knows exactly which beam is next to loose.

name: Waningpulley
description: Chalk a table of notch and range on a board all crews can read so none need to ask the captain.

name: Equipoise Tackle
description: Rack the spare slings and pins at the center of the battery where any crew can fetch them quickly.

name: Waning Rigging
description: Watch the fall of each engine's shot from the pole and call the correction to the crew at fault.

name: Swingbarrage
description: Loose the engines one after another along the line so a steady fall of shot never leaves the target.

name: Perceptive Hangcradle
description: Pass corrections down the line so every engine lands its shot within one marked patch of ground.

name: Vital Fulcrum
description: When one engine fouls the next in line takes up its mark so the barrage does not stutter.

name: Mayhemswing
description: Time the whole battery to land together so the combined fall breaks a block of ground under shot.

name: Furrowing Counterswing
description: Walk the fall of the whole battery in steps up the field so the enemy is driven back before it.

name: Chimearm
description: Drive a stake exactly between two engines and sight both beams from it so their arcs are known to each other.

name: Vital Slingpouch
description: Match the sills of both engines in height and rake so the paired shots leave at the same angle.

name: Might Pullrope
description: Two captains call the same count from two stations so both engines draw on one shared beat.

name: Heartening Ballast
description: Signal the sister engine with a flat hand held left or right to say whether its shot ran short.

name: Chime Slingpouch
description: Raise a blue cloth flag to mark the line both engines are laying on so no crew drifts from it.

name: Chimepulley
description: Watch the first engine's shot fall and call the miss to the second so its first throw already lands near the mark.

name: Tearing Swing
description: Loose the second engine a heartbeat after the first so both shots arrive at one place in turn.

name: Gust Whiplash
description: Throw the pair on arcs that cross in the air so the shots strike from two directions at one point.

name: Shortarm Maelstrom
description: Land the paired shots on either side of a target so the force closes in on the ground between them.

name: Raging Longarm
description: Throw the sister engine's shot on a flank threatening its partner so the first crew can reset unmolested.

name: Verity Rigging
description: Stretch a cord from the beam tip to the mark and sight along it as a hawk marks its prey.

name: Perceptive Shortarm
description: Read the cloud and the high wind of the open azure sky before choosing the weight of the shot.

name: Heartening Tackle
description: Hang a plumb cord over the mark and trace the line a falling stone will follow to it.

name: Pulleyelixir
description: Wind the arm to its highest notch so the sling frees at a steep angle.

name: Invigorating Pullrope
description: Trim the counterweight until the arm rises more upright and throws the stone nearly straight up.

name: Veritypulley
description: Listen for the echo of the landing off the basin slopes to judge distance beyond sight.

name: Gust Counterswing
description: Release at the high notch so the stone climbs steeply and plunges almost vertical onto the mark.

name: Rumble Letgo
description: Throw so the stone falls out of the sky onto a target with no chance to see it coming.

name: Rumble Rigging
description: Release two stones on tracks a breath apart so the second falls into the crater of the first.

name: Fulcrum Elixir
description: Read the splash and mist of a shot landing near the river to place the next stone through the haze.

name: Hollowswing
description: Put qi into the plunging stone so it pins a shielded target to the earth through the ward above it.

name: Quelling Shortarm
description: Drop stone after stone in a ring so the enemy dare not leave the circle of falling shot.

name: Might Longarm
description: Site each engine on firm ground along the basin shore with its sill level to the water line.

name: Tacklelinctus
description: Sight across the river bed to its far bank and note the distance by the landmarks that stand there.

name: Fortifying Hangcradle
description: Two flag-bearers on each flank keep the same beat so ranks of engines move as one.

name: Perceptive Fulcrum
description: Lay planks along the wet shore so the crews can run shot and rope without sinking.

name: Nova Counterswing
description: Loose the ranked engines one rank after another so shots fly over the river in unbroken waves.

name: Ballast Assault
description: Lift the shot high over the river so it falls on the far bank beyond the reach of ready hands.

name: Ponderous Heaveoff
description: Walk the fall of two ranks up the far bank so the enemy there cannot gather.

name: Siltpulley
description: Sweep stone after stone along a bend of the river so the whole far shore is under the fall.

name: Swingthrash
description: Throw the left rank and the right rank to land together so the ground between is closed in on both sides.

name: Armelixir
description: Speak the crew's oath aloud before the first winding so each hand is bound to the throw.

name: Chime Ballast
description: Take a bearing from the wind banner and hold it in the mind through every shot.

name: Tackleremedy
description: Hold up an open palm to feel the gale's strength and angle and shift the aim to it.

name: Mindful Hangcradle
description: Set the sill on the plateau rock with iron pins driven into cracks so no gust shifts it.

name: Vital Pullrope
description: Trim the sling cords shorter against a gale so the stone leaves the pouch low and quick.

name: Vigorous Releasehook
description: Fix the eyes on the horizon line so the throw keeps its bearing as the wind shifts.

name: Blaze Overthrow
description: Loose the shot on the spoken oath word so every hand lets go at the same breath.

name: Ravaging Whiplash
description: Throw on the held bearing through a swirling gust so the stone keeps its line across the plateau.

name: Hoarfrost Heaveoff
description: Lean the throw into a rising gale so the stone rides the wind to a longer carry.

name: Grinding Whiplash
description: Sustain a barrage on a bearing through the gale so the enemy cannot advance across open ground.

name: Iron Swing
description: Put qi into a stone released on a gust so the wind adds force and drives it through a ward.

name: Mightarm
description: Set the engine a fixed distance back from the plateau edge so the throw clears the drop.

name: Perceptive Tackle
description: Mark bearings on the stone with pegs and cord so crews can find them again by feel.

name: Ballast Elixir
description: Anchor the sill to the bare rock with iron pins so a hard release cannot move the engine.

name: Remnant Longarm
description: Watch the grass and dust at the edge to read how the wind bends over the drop.

name: Armremedy
description: Spread the crew around the engine with space between each so no single gust can bowl them over together.

name: Facet Hangcradle
description: Throw so the stone clears the plateau edge and falls on the slope or the plain below.

name: Hoarfrost Releasehook
description: Correct the next throw from the first fall with one shift of the bearing.

name: Unmaking Counterswing
description: Let the shot fall short of the foe on a slope so it rolls and bounds into them.

name: Lambasting Whiplash Onslaught
description: Rain stone along a bearing over the plateau edge so a column climbing the slope is struck again and again.

name: Ponderous Overthrow
description: Hold a lone engine on its bearing against a force that thinks it unguarded and keep it from the edge.

name: Vitalarm
description: Haul the rope on a sworn count chanted by the whole team so every back moves at once.

name: Tackleelixir
description: Set the heels and the hips into the gale so the whole team leans against it as one.

name: Remnant Slingpouch
description: Check the rope's line from the beam to the team against the engine's bearing before the pull begins.

name: Intenttackle
description: Rest the team in place during a heavy gust with the rope held taut and the beam unmoved.

name: Rumblepulley
description: Let the whole team loose the rope on the oath word so the beam throws the stone with the full pull behind it.

name: Discerning Releasehook
description: Hold the rope against a wind that would tear the beam over and keep the engine under the team's will.

name: Swingassault
description: Send the combined force of the whole team's qi through the beam at release so the stone breaks a ward.

name: Implacable Slingpouch
description: Brace the team's qi around the engine so a storm gust cannot topple the beam or shatter the frame.
